headline: 10 Michigan deals, $31.7M raised — led by Noblestone Credit Select III LLC

top_deals.summary: Noblestone Credit Select III LLC, a Southfield-based real estate company, filed a $25M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $2.5M sold to 16 investors.
University Bancorp, Inc., an Ann Arbor-based commercial banking company, filed a $25M debt offering under Rule 506(b); $25M sold to 5 investors.
High Street Holdco, LLC, a Traverse City-based company, filed a Form D tied to a business combination (acquisition or merger); $3.7M of equity and options/warrants issued to 1 investor.

top_deals.company: Moer Venture Fund A Series of V360 Holdings LLC
top_deals.summary: Moer Venture Fund A Series of V360 Holdings LLC, a Grand Rapids-based venture capital fund, disclosed a $2.2M raise; $0 sold.
Swarm Defense Technologies, Inc., an Auburn Hills-based technology company, filed a $2M SAFE offering under Rule 506(b); $2M sold to 3 investors. (Amended filing.)

new_funds.company: Moer Venture Fund A Series of V360 Holdings LLC
new_funds.summary: Moer Venture Fund A Series of V360 Holdings LLC, a Grand Rapids-based venture capital fund, disclosed a $2.2M raise; $0 sold.
Seiche Fund I LP, a Novi-based hedge fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $0 sold.

notable_ma.summary: High Street Holdco, LLC, a Traverse City-based company, filed a Form D tied to a business combination (acquisition or merger); $3.7M of equity and options/warrants issued to 1 investor.
ASP Isotopes Inc. and others reported a 15.1% stake in ENDRA Life Sciences Inc. (NDRA).

material_agreements.summary: Stoneridge Inc (SRI) entered into a material definitive agreement (employment agreement).

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $31.7M sold across 7 Form D filings this week, down 64% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Noblestone Credit Select III LLC (Southfield, Other Real Estate) targeting $25M. Good question to ask: are founders in real estate favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
High Street Holdco, LLC disclosed a deal. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan financial services assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

2 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $0 raised so far — led by Moer Venture Fund A Series of V360 Holdings LLC (Venture Capital Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
